title: sharpen-verify — the Verifiability lens (issue-sharpening 02)
description: One fresh reviewer's verdict on each acceptance criterion of a proposed issue body: can the Refuter mark it from the diff and from what `.fabro/ci.sh` runs. `audit_gate` checks the Input receipt and judges the round. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

criteria.description: One entry per bullet under `## Acceptance criteria` of proposed.md, in order.

verdict.description: checkable_from_diff: the diff shows it. checkable_by_ci: a command `.fabro/ci.sh` runs shows it. unverifiable: neither.

why.description: For checkable_by_ci, the ci.md line; for checkable_from_diff, what in the diff shows it; for unverifiable, what is missing.

findings.description: What is wrong with the proposal. [] when nothing is.

severity.description: blocker: the proposal must not be applied as it is. major: a real problem that must be fixed first. nit: worth saying, never blocks.

criterion_ref.description: `AC<n>` of the original criterion the finding is about, or null when it is about the whole proposal.

evidence.description: Where the finding comes from: path:line in the checkout, `proposed.md`, `changes.md`, `original_criteria.md` or `ci.md`.

says.description: What is there, quoted or in one sentence.
